hook: A protein-evolution AI guided two lab campaigns to enzyme variants over 10 times more active than wild type
summary: ProTEUS is a model that predicts effects of mutations, trained on deep mutational scanning data, and uses lab feedback to steer evolution. It beat established models on mutation prediction, and its fast structure predictor runs over 10 times faster than AlphaFold3. Campaigns on aldehyde dehydrogenase and levansucrase gave variants with over 10-fold higher activity. Only two enzymes were tested.
title: ProTEUS: A mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution
